Full-stack Engineer
Loop Studio, Remote (US)

About the role
Loop Studio is a four-person team building collaboration tools for podcast producers.

Requirements
At least 4 years of full-stack experience.
Frontend product work in React.
Backend services in Node.js.
Relational data modeling with PostgreSQL.

Nice to have
Deployment experience on AWS.

Responsibilities
Ship features across the whole stack.
Talk to users weekly and turn feedback into fixes.
Keep the test suite trustworthy.
